description: Log time spent on an issue, as yourself — the same entry the issue's «Time logged» block shows and the stats screen counts. 'timeSpent' as a person writes it: '1h 30m', '1h30m', '2h', '45m', '1.5h', '1d' (a day is 8 hours, a week 5 days); a bare number is minutes. 'started' is when the work was done (ISO 8601, e.g. '2026-11-24T10:00:00+03:00'); now when left out. At most 31 days in one entry. Requires permission to edit the issue. Answers with the entry and the issue's total.

comment.description: What was done, in a sentence. Optional.

started.description: When the work was done, ISO 8601. Now when left out.
